revisionNotes: 2026-09-27: first floor recorded from the verified CZU run (107 of 186 register rows carry a school-owned programme page).

2026-09-27: raised after the first full rotation of the never-read-first sweep. 760 of 5019 register rows now carry a school-owned programme page across 17 schools; the 33 smallest schools were still unread (budget_exhausted_before_school) and stay at 0, so they are not floored. Ten links, one per floored school, were re-fetched live and all answered on the school's own domain before the floor was committed.

2026-09-27: the 18 links UJEP, CVUT and MUNI served only over plain http were promoted to https (one bounded read of the https twin each, all 200 on the school's own domain), so the published inventory keeps all 760 proven links instead of the 742 the https-only gate had kept. The resolver now does that promotion itself and the inventory build reports what it drops, so a school's own page is not lost to the scheme again.
